description: Labeled matchup cases for evaluating the Fight Night Matchup pipeline. Each case has facts the analysis MUST surface (must_mention, keyword OR-groups), claims it MUST NOT make (must_not_claim), and free-text notes describing what an ideal analysis looks like.

cases.notes: Classic wrestler-vs-striker. Makhachev's elite takedowns vs Gaethje's elite TD defense (90%) but high strikes-absorbed should be the central tension. An ideal analysis frames the fight as 'can Islam get Gaethje down', not 'can Gaethje out-wrestle Islam'.

Oliveira is the all-time UFC submissions leader but has porous TD defense (~53%). Tsarukyan is a top wrestler. Analysis should identify Oliveira's sub threat from his back AND his vulnerability to being grinded.

must_not_claim: McGregor is on a win streak
cases.notes: McGregor's recent form is ALL losses (last 3 fights). Analysis should weight Poirier's recent form heavily. Both southpaws — stance is not a factor.

must_not_claim: Rodriguez has higher striking volume than Holloway
cases.notes: Holloway is the highest-volume striker in UFC history (~7.2 SLpM). Rodriguez is creative/unorthodox but lower volume. Analysis should pick up the volume gap as a striking advantage for Holloway.

must_not_claim: Volkanovski has never been knocked out
cases.notes: Volk is coming off back-to-back KO losses (Topuria + Makhachev). Topuria's last five are all wins including KOing Volk. Recent-form weighting should pick this up.
Strickland's high-volume jab + tight defense gave Adesanya trouble historically. Strickland is famously light-handed despite high volume.

must_not_claim: Whittaker wants the fight on the ground
cases.notes: Chimaev's elite wrestling vs Whittaker's elite TD defense (85%) is the central question. Whittaker is a technical striker, NOT a wrestler.
Rakhmonov has finished every UFC opponent. Belal is durable but doesn't finish. Analysis should frame Rakhmonov's finishing rate vs Belal's grind-it-out style.
Pereira's power kickboxing vs Prochazka's unorthodox/wild style. Pereira already KO'd Prochazka in their first fight.
Jones is 38 with a massive reach (84.5"); Aspinall is 33 and one of the most explosive HWs ever. Age gap and Jones's reach are the dominant variables.
Pavlovich is a pure puncher with zero takedown attempts; Blaydes is one of the best HW wrestlers ever. Wrestling-vs-striking is the entire fight.
Merab averages 6.5 TDs per 15 min — one of the highest rates in UFC history. O'Malley has a 5-inch reach advantage but Merab's pace and wrestling dictate the fight.
